title: The Best-Designed Town in the Netherlands (and therefore, the world)
summary: Not Just Bikes tours Houten, a Dutch town designed around cycling, explaining how its layout makes most trips by bike safe and easy. It also promotes a book about the town.
why: HN uses it as an example that car-free, leafy suburbs where kids can bike independently are possible.

quote.text: It's possible to build a low density suburb that kids can bike through safely
